prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunny plaza at the foot of glass skyscrapers with pale paving, a low fountain edge, standard-height glass doors and benches, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Japanese woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, smooth healthy skin, defined brown-mauve eyeshadow, a precise winged liner, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, softly contoured cheeks, glossy rose-nude lips, a poised, mature, confident expression, cool ash-brown hair styled in a mohawk with volume along the centre of the scalp, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted emerald drop, and on the other ear a large gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a bronze hammer head, a gold small flared temple bell, a gold round bell, a gold barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three gold anklets. Extremely long stiletto nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a minimal hot pink leopard-print leather micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, paired with a hot pink leopard-print leather micro-bikini top reduced to two tiny opaque triangles on thin strings tied at the neck and back, each just big enough to cover only her nipple and nothing more, leaving the rest of her bust visible around them, her stomach fully visible below.
LEFT Pose: mid-stride walking toward camera.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Russian man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful boy-group center idol face with neat sharp brows, a slim nose and glossy full lips, clean-shaven, glass-skin makeup with a faint shimmer on the cheekbones, pale smooth skin with a cool undertone, a soft amused smile, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in high ponytail, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long silver chain ending in one large faceted pearl-cluster drop, and on the other ear a large brass hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (an iron teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver ship's anchor, an iron chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a copper hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single rose-gold necklace. RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily tall and large man, far beyond any real person, with a men's physique build. Enormously broad shoulders with round capped deltoids, a wide upper chest tapering sharply to a very narrow waist in a dramatic V-taper, a lean sharply defined six-pack abdomen with visible obliques, thick strong arms, and long lean athletic legs that are muscular but not bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing nothing but the smallest possible white leopard-print leather micro pouch cut tight to the body on two thin side strings tied high at the hips and a thin strap at the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his skin otherwise fully bare.
RIGHT Pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme gold platform stiletto cross-strap sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
